title: Gmsh MSH format
overview: Gmsh is a mesh generator and MSH interchange format. OneFLOW currently targets ASCII MSH 4.1 first, with MSH 2.2 ASCII compatibility as a secondary format. The adapter must preserve node and element tags, ordering, entity dimensions/tags, physical names and memberships.
principle: MSH separates geometric entities from physical groups. MSH 4.1 stores nodes and elements in entity blocks; tags are sparse identities, not dense offsets. $MeshFormat declares version and encoding; $PhysicalNames stores dimension-tagged names; $Entities associates entities and physical groups; $Nodes and $Elements store entity blocks. A physical group is not a OneFLOW boundary-condition type.
architecture: MSH parser -> format-owned entity blocks, node/element tags and physical memberships -> neutral MeshSnapshot -> explicit semantic mapping -> Mesh Core. File parsing remains independent of the optional Gmsh SDK.

proves: Current C++ reader validates and summarizes supported ASCII MSH 4.1 records.
Knowledge distinguishes entity blocks, sparse tags and physical-group semantics.
does_not_prove: Binary MSH and all high-order element families are supported.
Placeholder .cgns output is a legal CGNS file.
